## Summary

Describe the user-visible or maintenance change.

## Change type

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] User-facing feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build, CI, or repository maintenance

## Validation

List the commands or manual checks you ran, and note anything not tested.

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests and checks pass, or failures are explained.
- [ ] User-facing behavior and documentation are updated together.
- [ ] No credentials, persistent state, private hostnames, or sensitive logs are included.
- [ ] Security-sensitive issues were reported privately rather than in this PR.
